notes.title: Update 1.1 is now available
notes.notes:
Before starting, a few important notes:

 Some translations are still missing, but we wanted to update the game first and we can still patch the 1.1 version on Steam with new translations.
 Gostique & Nemrod, our two new coders on the updates, will be working on the 1.2 version that’ll be pushed in beta once in a while – find how to activate Neurodeck Beta at the end of this post. It should be released next month.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/d0b664893e12348417515a927d8a381ddd3e5daa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/27b7af6383722fae46b8bc9863ae861f6e244d77.png
Here’s what's in 1.1 patch note:

 The exploration scene has been revamped a bit, it’s now displaying some stuff better as well as the pacing changes we made;
 Pacing changes make basically a shorter game, but with a mini-boss in the middle and a boss at the end. Future updates will add more unlockable stuff;
 The fight phases have seen some stuff changed and revamped, such as Theophobia rules and stamina & sanity feedback display;
 Rooms Meditation: unlocks permanent stats for the run;
 “Survey” should propose a little less of the surveys you already answered, some work is still needed on this;
 You’ll see “Nightmare phobias,” which has improved attacks and health points. The display is a bit poor at the moment but we want to make it clearer.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/e6b29c5ff7f20bd58cf53a1746fa73245862e6b0.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/76b7ffc3ec2469fd5ae6f5db6cbbca22570cbcb0.png

Here is what’s planned for 1.2:

 New cards
 New rooms
 New resilience levels
 New nursery traits
 New achievements
 Improving the game feel
 Reworking the unlock system

Please keep in mind we might encounter challenges so some of those changes might get delayed.

Please let us know if you encounter any bugs or things to improve! We’re aware that you're all committed for at least 3 months of work but you’ll see patches every month!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/d05171925a9e8a7f9bc42f976261ba499bf96c2c.png

Switch release

Switch release has been delayed and will be available at the end of the series of patches on Steam.

notes.title: Make your update suggestions for Neurodeck
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've seen the reviews are mixed and we understand that the game has some problems or that some features of the game are less appreciated by the players and reviewers.

In the interest of making improvements, we would like to see what we can do for future updates. We love working with the community and we want to read your opinions and suggestions!

Feel free to answer the following question:
If you could improve ONE thing in Neurodeck, what would it be?

Tell us in the comment section!

notes.title: Big Patch 0.3.8
notes.notes:
This beginning of November brings us closer to release!

There are a lot of new stuff, but we'll not start to differentiate the beta and public demo branch.

Private Beta : ask for access on Discord. Features the whole content.
Public Demo : play easily on Steam, but you can only play the first character and the first emotion.

What changed :

Gameplay


 This update introduces Neurodeck’s new character, “Jupiter”. She comes with a new “Inner Peace” mechanic that takes the place of Lei’s “Mind Focus”, a new “Meditate” keyword, and 34 new cards. As of now the character has only its first “Sadness” emotion available.
 Added a new phobia! Or two actually? Nyctophobia represents the fear of the dark, and Heliophobia represents the fear of intense light. The phobia alternates between these two phases in battle, and you will need to think strategically to defeat this powerful opponent!
 Added another new phobia : Nosophobia, the fear of diseases. This one constitutes another boss you can  encounter at the end of the Neurodeck maze, as well as Phasmo for example. We hope it will give players an interesting battle!
 You cannot encounter two phobias of the same kind (two “Arachno” for exemple) anymore. This is part of a small rework we are currently doing on encounters, more about that soon!




Balancing

As we are introducing a lot of content on this update, balancing might change a bit in the following weeks. Feedback on this point really helps us to understand what works best and what should be reworked, so feel free to share your thoughts with us!

Visual


 15 new card illustrations have been added to the game.
 Nycto/Heliophobia and Nosophobia come with new animations!
 Reworked the card template. This one should be more aesthetically pleasing and allows for a better display of important informations.


UX


 The new card template now indicates the pool a card comes from : for example, if it’s tied to an emotion or common to all emotions of a specific character.
 Fixed a display problem on the text on Squalophobia’s second attack.


Team

Whaïd joined the team ! He is doing a work-and-study program in video game development and will help in the development of Neurodeck. 

Bug fixing 


 Fixed bugs occuring when Jupiter card effects were played.
 Fixed bugs tied to the Meditation Jauge of Jupiter. 
 Fixed bugs tied to the new “Inner Peace” effect.
 Fixed problem tied to music and sound effects, that could stop playing on specific circumstances.
 Fixed a bug where the wrong name could display on cards (“Lei” instead of “Jupiter” for exemple).
 Fixed a problem on tutorial that prevented it to display in game.


What is planned for the upcoming weeks? 


 The second emotion of Jupiter” is currently in a pre-production phase. We are working on it, and it should release around january.
 We are currently reworking the encounters in nerodeck in order to make the difficulty curve more interesting. There’s already a modification in this update, and it will be continued in the next. 
 New art will replace the placeholder illustrations on some of Jupiter’s cards.

notes.title: September update - 0.2.8
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/6a203d3815103359cee30e8dc230e68761d56a7c.jpg

Hello everyone!
A lot of changes going into the alpha version! It will only be an alpha (access through our Discord!). It is very hard to process through all the changes that went into this update, sorry if it's not complete!

What changed :

Gameplay


 This update introduces the Neurodeck’s “unlock system”. Some cards are now locked at the beginning of a run, and the player can unlock them through the new “Memory Revival” room.
 Added a new kind of cards that can give players passive effects on several turns. These effects are a bit stronger than modifiers, and will allow players to try new strategies.
 Added a new “Memorial” room. It allows you to remove a card from your deck during a run.
 *Added a new “Kitchen” room. It allows you to get powerful temporary buffs, in anticipation of a specific fight.*
 The maze is now composed of 30 floors (instead of 20).
 This update adds a new emotion for Lei : the “Surprise” emotion. “Surprise” comes with a new basic card and 15 new cards you can find during runs including unique effects, passives and equipments. We hope you’ll like it!
 Added 7 other new cards : “Flip a Coin”, “Stroll”, “Sunbath”, “Recycling” and “House Party” for the “Anger” emotion of Lei, “Caring Thought” and “Meditation Session” for all emotions of Lei.
 Added “Sharkophobia” (rank 2) to the game. It can devour your cards!
 Added “Haptophobia” (rank 1) to the game. It can “lock” your cards in place, making them impossible to play.
 Phobia must now be fought once to be present in the “phobiadex”.
 Controller support is currently in QA but you can try it :) Should work with keyboard as well.


Balancing


 “Shower” is now belongs to rank 2 (previously : rank 3). Its STA cost increased a bit (from 0 to 15).
 “Self-Blaming” now belongs at rank 3 (previously : rank 2).
 “Angry Scribbling” was nerfed a little bit and now fades after use.
 “Phasmophobia” has now 120 Sanity points (+ 20)


Visual


 Added a new illustration for the Can Kicking and Self-Blaming cards.
 Added animations for Tokophobia, Sharkophobia, Agoraphobia, Phasmophobia and Squalophobia.
 Events now have specific icons in exploration mode.
 Added a new “Forest” background, the old one is now called “Shrooms”.
 Added illustrations for 9 of the new cards present in the Surprise emotion.


Sound


 Added SFX for Entomophobia, masculinity, and much more...


UX


 The fight interface now shows the number of Faded/Discarded cards this fight.


Team

Sophie Maleval joined the team as a 2D artist. She has been making new illustrations for Neurodeck (some of which were previewed on Twitter in the last weeks). She’s already finished but helped making around 20+ illustrations as a helping hand!


Bug fixing 


 Fixed the Introverted/Extraverted survey (it could give players the wrong trait).
 Fixed animations that could blur on Myso and Arachno.
 Fixed bugs tied to new cards and effects.
 Fixed a visual bug on monster Sanity.
 Fixed a bug on the amount of Sanity of the “Eel Punching” trial.
 Fixed a sound bug that could crash the game.
 .... and many more!


Other


 Agora’s attack names have changed in this version
 The card “French Insult” is now called “Altercation” (the effect is the same)





What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 

The second character of Neurodeck, “Jupiter”, is currently in a pre-production phase. We should release its first emotion in the coming month, with a new mechanic tied to the character.
We are working on controller support! It should be added to the game later this year.
New phobias will be added to the game in a future update. They will diversify our current pool, and offer a new variety of challenges to players. This update already adds 2 phobias for the lower ranks (1 & 2). We are aiming for

notes.title: Update V.0.2.7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Update V.0.2.7 is here! It adds new trials, new traits and UX improvements/bug fixing.

https://i.imgur.com/shWn0lz.jpg

What changed : 

Gameplay
• We added 5 new surveys and 9 traits. A lot of these traits are still WIP, but it will give you an idea of the upcoming content for the next updates!
• Library now duplicates a card from your deck instead of removing it

Visual
• Added new animations for the Herpeto, Myso and Toko phobias. New Idle animation on Arachno.

UX
• Replaced icons in some places (“End Turn” button for exemple)
• Changed the game’s icon
• Cards were too big and hard to manipulate, we changed it but it still needs tweaking

Bug fixing
• Fixed a bug that made the debug mode appear in previous versions (9999 actions, all fights are against one specific phobia etc.)
• Fixed a visual bug on traits equipment/desequipment
• Fixed a visual bug on modifiers that weren’t appearing properly

notes.title: Update V.0.2.6
notes.notes:
Hi @everyone, update V.0.2.6 is here! This one adds a new game mode and UX/UI improvements.

https://i.imgur.com/EdL42Rr.jpg

What changed : 

Gameplay
• Added a new “mental trials” game mode. This game offers a selection of challenges to solve with a defined deck. This update contains 4 trials, but we plan to make more of them in the future!
• We are also introducing a new kind of persistent effects. These can be added by cards, monster attacks and rooms in the main game. There is not a lot of them in the game currently, but you’ll see some new effects appear in the next updates!
• The name of game jauges changed to better fit the game’s theme. This might be confusing for players that are used to “Sanity” and “HP” labels. As of now, player life will be refered as “Sanity”, and the points used to play cards and actions will be refered as “Stamina”. Here is a picture of the new interface: 

https://i.imgur.com/wsMX3BP.png

Cards
• We reworked the design of our cards. Tell us what you think of it!
• Changed the name of the base equipment of the “Joy” emotion.

Balancing
• We’re investigating some cards of the “Joy” emotion, but as of now we don’t see a card as specially problematic. Do not hesitate to tell us if you think this is the case.

Visual
• Three new illustrations have been added to the game : Clunky Car, Shower, Spicy Food (all three on the “Joy” pool)

UX
• Added a tooltip on cards that create “Deep breath”.
• Improved phobia animations 

Bug fixing
• Fixed a bug where “lucky” rewards (containing cards of an higher rarity) at the end of a fight could give players a card from another pool
• Fixed a bug that caused the tooltip of the second equipment to not display on hover
• Fixed animation bugs on Herpeto.
• Fixed a bug occuring in the Classroom with the new card design.
• Fixed bugs tied to the trials

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36907763/25c2d0adceaff42abe3ccc39bbc9e99ba8cc0ce6.png

Audio
• Added ambiances for some rooms
• Added sound effects on modifiers
• Adjusted the volume on some sound elements

What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 
• We will progressively add new illustrations for the “Joy” emotion of Lei. It will replace the beta art currently present in the cards.
• New phobias are coming! They will diversify the current pool and challenge players in different ways.
• We will correct the typos currently present in the game. This will come in a future patch.

notes.title: Update V.0.2.5
notes.notes:
Update V.0.2.5 is here! It adds a lot of content : new cards, new illustrations, enemy animations, sound and music, balancing, bug fixing and much more.

https://i.imgur.com/g8hrMhO.jpg

What changed : 

Gameplay
Added a new “Meditation” room that allows you to unlock the traits/phobias/deck informations.
Card pools are now differentiated between each emotion. Some cards are “neutral” (common to all emotions), and other are tied to one specific emotion
New “Collection” tab on the menu, where you can see all cards in the game. It’s still WIP, but it will give you an overview of the feature
A new “Mental Trials” tab has appeared on the main menu. It’s not active currently, but you will learn more about it soon
You can now equip traits directly after a survey

Cards
Added new content for the “Joy” emotion of Lei. 13 new cards with a lot of unique effects have been added to the game! It should allow you to try a lot of different strategies
Two new base cards have been added to the “Joy” emotion of Lei
The “Resentment”, “Inner Strength” and “Friends” cards now belong to the “Joy” card pool (you can’t find them anymore with “Anger”)
Neutral pool : added the “Psychology Book” equipment to the game
Neutral pool : removed “Lullaby”  from the game. It might come back someday with another design, but we felt it was not an interesting option for players to pick
Neutral pool : removed “Growth” for the same reason
Neutral pool : removed “Anarchy”, that will be reworked
Anger pool : removed “Letting go” (might be replaced by something else in the future)
Anger pool : reworked “Big Cleaning” (new effect)
Reworked Retrogaming, Alcohol (neutral pool) and Inner Strength (Joy pool) to make them more simple

Balancing
Nerfed Blennophobia. You can now fight it without risking nightmares
Nerfed Warm Tea, that now draws only two cards (down from three)
Nerfed the “Resourceful” trait, that now draws only two cards at the beginning of a fight (down from three)
Small nerf on the “Adventurous” trait (now gives 4 HP per trigger instead of 5)

Visual
Added new illustrations for “Anger” : Comfy Bed, Kombucha, Flow, Spooning
Added new illustrations for neutral cards : Broom, Pain Pill
Changed the “Self-Harm” card name to “Tattoos”. Added the correspondent illustration to the game.
Changed the “Therapy Session” card name to “Stressball”. Added the correspondent illustration to the game
Added animations to the game : Arachnophobia, Herpetophobia, ToxicMascu and Entomophobia are now animated.
In game, HP and SAN heal is now animated

Audio
Added menu, fight and exploration musics.
Added sound effects to Arachnophobia
Added sound effects to Blennophobia
Added sound effects to fights: start of a turn, phobia attacks, playing cards and more
Added sound effects to the Gymnasium room
Added UI sounds

UX
Discarded cards are now shown to the player.
Added screenshake on some elements
Added a visual effect that triggers when the player heals

Bug fixing
Fixed a bug occuring when a card was supposed to be played on discard
Fixed a bug on the display of the tutorial.
Fixed a bug occuring on equipments that gave actions to the player (ex: Friends)
Fixed a bug that affected Gymnasium options
Fixed some bugs occuring when the new effects were triggered.
Fixed bugs tied to the new features
Fixed a problem on the “Deep Breath” card (created by some cards of “Joy”)
Fixed a problem with the “Nails Chew” card
Fixed sprite and animation bugs

Team 
Tilianna and Nicolas joined the team! They are working on music and sound effects to give Neurodeck a distinct atmosphere. You can hear some of their works in the new version of the game!

What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 
We will progressively add new illustrations for the “Joy” emotion of Lei. It will replace the beta art currently present in the cards.
New phobias are coming! They will diversify the current pool and challenge players in different ways.
As we introduced a lot of cards at once, expect some balancing in the next weeks. Player feedback is very useful on this point, so feel free to tell us about your experience! 
New cards will be added to the “Anger” and “Neutral” pools.
New sound effects and musics will be integrated to the game, and will contribute to shape an unique atmosphere for Neurodeck.
New “stories” will be added to rooms and will help us integrate more narrative elements to the game.
The new “Mental Trials” game mode will be added to the game at some point. More about this later!

notes.title: Update V.0.2.4
notes.notes:
Update V.0.2.4 is here! It adds a new room preview feature for the exploration phase, balancing on cards and phobias and UX improvements. 

https://i.imgur.com/4QzfNij.jpg


What changed : 

Gameplay

Nerfed “Comfy Bed”. The card is now at Tier 2 and has only 1 durability.
Nerfed the “Lazy” trait. It now gives less stacks of modifiers.
Reduced the cost of “Moving”, “Writing about day”, “Big Cleaning”, “Kombucha” and “Anarchy”
Buffed “Kombucha” : it now heals 15 HP for each equipment.
Buffed the phobias “Herpetophobia” and “ToxicMascu” 
Buffed the phobia boss “Phasmo”

Visual

Fixed some problems on the animations of “Blennophobia”
The exploration has a new preview system (top of the screen)

The new preview system now indicates the rooms where the player will face phobias

UX

Improved visual effects on the main menu
Added modifier tooltips on phobia attacks
Harmonized the display of modifiers
Active equipements give you a preview of their card on hover.

Bug fixing

Fixed a bug that blocked the “Main Menu” button on the defeat screen.
Fixed a problem with the display of modifiers on cards on the player’s hand.
Fixed a bug on “ToxicMascu” attacks.
Fixed a bug on the survey “Lazy vs. Neat Freak”
Fixed a bug on the description of the “Anxiety” modifier
Classroom will now convert correctly the cards
Fixed a bug with the “Permadeck” interface

What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 

We will focus on reshaping the second emotion of Jupiter (“Joy”). It will include new exclusive cards for this emotion, that will allow you to find new strategies to defeat phobias.
You will progressively see new animations be integrated in the game. Fights will be more dynamic and have different atmospheres depending on the specific phobias.

You can download the new build now in the beta branch on Steam. We would love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Neurodeck : Update V.0.2.2
notes.notes:
Hi folks, Update V.0.2.2 is now live ! 

You can get a key by joining the newsletter or Discord.
Check out : https://neurodeck-game.com/ for more details.

What changed : 

Gameplay

- Global balancing on phobias, with the intent of raising the difficulty by a little bit and to further differentiate the fights.
- Balancing on cards : we nerfed some that we felt were too powerful at this time, and buffed other cards that seemed underpowered. Special thanks to the players that answered our small survey on Discord!
- Added 4 cards : Resentment, Inner Strength, Kombucha and Grandpa’s Medal.
- Moved “Entomophobia” up in ranking : you will encounter this powerful foe later in your run.
- You can now equip passive abilities on the trait pannel in the exploration menu (it has a small book icon). “Meditation” rooms do not appear anymore in runs.

Team 

- Jeanne has joined the team as a 2D animator! She will work in collaboration with Victoria in order to give life to the phobias that dwell in your mind and on the Neurodeck system. 

Bugs 

- Fixed a few bugs tied to the application of buffs/debuffs on enemies.


What is planned for the upcoming weeks ? 

- We will focus on reshaping the second emotion of Jupiter (“Joy”). It will include new exclusive cards for this emotion, that will allow you to find new strategies to defeat phobias.
- Game difficulty is one of the subjects we are working on currently. We’re trying to find the right balance between “too easy” and “too hard” for the game, so there might be some changes in the next updates. Feedback are super useful on this, so feel free to tell us what you think of its current state!
- You will progressively see new animations be integrated in the game. Fights will be more dynamic and have different atmospheres depending on the specific phobias.
- New art for the cards is coming up ! Stay tuned :)

You can download the new build now in the beta branch on Steam. We would love to hear your feedback!
